update_log: Exhaustive compilation of highly tested Himalayan and Peninsular mountain passes, including connectivity, vital tunnels, and border tri-junctions for Geography Static GK.

northern_himalayan_passes_jk_and_ladakh.key_fact: Crucial lifeline to Ladakh. The Z-Morh and Zoji La tunnels are being constructed to provide all-weather connectivity.
Located in the Pir Panjal Range. The famous Jawahar Tunnel (inaugurated in 1956) passes under it.

northern_himalayan_passes_jk_and_ladakh.connects: Leh to Nubra and Shyok Valleys
northern_himalayan_passes_jk_and_ladakh.key_fact: Historically known as one of the highest motorable passes in the world (approx 5,359 m).
Officially holds the Guinness World Record for the highest motorable road in the world at 19,024 feet, built by BRO (Project Himank).
An ancient pass situated on the historic caravan route between Srinagar and Gilgit.

central_himalayan_passes_hp_and_uttarakh.connects: Kullu Valley to Lahaul and Spiti Valleys
central_himalayan_passes_hp_and_uttarakh.key_fact: The 9.02 km long Atal Tunnel (longest highway single-tube tunnel above 10,000 feet) bypasses this pass for year-round connectivity.
The Sutlej River enters India from Tibet through this pass. It is one of India's major border posts for trade with China.
Located in the Zanskar range, it connects Manali to Leh. The Chenab river originates near this pass (Bhaga and Chandra rivers).
A highly strategic border tri-junction between India, Nepal, and China. Used heavily by pilgrims for the Kailash Mansarovar Yatra.
Mana Pass is located within the Nanda Devi Biosphere Reserve and serves as an ancient trade route to Tibet.

eastern_himalayan_passes_sikkim_and_nort.key_fact: Formed a branch of the ancient Silk Road. Closed after the 1962 Sino-Indian War and reopened in 2006 to facilitate border trade.
Passes through the Chumbi Valley. It is relatively more accessible than Nathu La for trade.
Highly strategic pass providing the main connectivity between the Tawang Valley and the rest of India.
A strategic tri-junction pass at the easternmost point of India (near the McMahon Line).

peninsular_passes_western_ghats.key_fact: A critical mountain pass in the Western Ghats that provides a route for the busy Mumbai-Kolkata and Mumbai-Delhi railway/highway networks.
Situated on the crest of the Western Ghats; vital for the Mumbai-Chennai and Mumbai-Bengaluru connectivity.
A major geographic break in the Western Ghats located between the Nilgiri Hills to the north and the Anaimalai Hills to the south.
Located further south of the Palakkad gap, serving as an essential trade and transport route between the two states.
